peru_uit.note: Peru's Unidad Impositiva Tributaria (UIT), a reference value the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) sets annually by supreme decree. Multiple routes in this dataset (permanent residence, naturalisation) peg their income/economic-solvency thresholds to a multiple of the UIT (commonly 10 UIT/year). The 2026 figure (S/5,500, per Decreto Supremo N.301-2025-EF) was confirmed via two tier-3/tier-4 legal-news sources describing the decree, not an independently fetched MEF/El Peruano decree PDF -- treat as a snapshot pending a direct government re-verification.

sources.title: LP Derecho (legal news publication) -- reporting on Decreto Supremo N.301-2025-EF, which sets Peru's UIT for 2026 at S/5,500
